tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Night: the navy sky behind Hero → Timeline. Parchment: print, docs and light pages.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: the vignette at the emblem's centre, marquee band, footer.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised panels and demo cards on surface. Night value derived (not sampled).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and display type (Thai + Latin) on surface, surface-deep and surface-raised — ≥9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Body paragraphs on surface and surface-raised (≥9.7:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata and descriptions on surface and surface-raised (≥5.4:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card outlines only — never the sole border of a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (Button primary), selected MajorTile ring, active DiamondDots.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (≈10:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring, offset 2px; ≥9:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy (sampled from the site). Night sky ground; ink on parchment.

tokens.name: navy-ink
tokens.usage: Darkest navy (sampled), vignettes and glow cores.

tokens.name: champagne
tokens.usage: Champagne gold (sampled): all heading text on navy.

tokens.name: gold-solid
tokens.usage: Solid gold (sampled): the bright end of the MajorTile gradient, tracked labels.

tokens.name: logo-gold
tokens.usage: Main fill of the logo's W, 21 and zodiac ring (sampled from the logo PNG).

tokens.name: gold-highlight
tokens.usage: Specular highlight on the logo's gold bevel; the brightest gold.

tokens.name: gold-shadow
tokens.usage: Shaded side of the logo's gold bevel. Decorative only — 4.7:1 on navy, not for body text.

tokens.name: compass-slate
tokens.usage: Stroke of the compass-star inside the logo ring. Decorative line colour; 4.5:1 on parchment.

tokens.name: celestial-blue
tokens.usage: The blue halo behind the glow logo. Glow and atmosphere only (3.8:1 on navy — never text).

tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: Parchment (sampled): torn-edge cards, the Timeline box, map/cloud shapes.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Decorative circles in the YWC21 intro section.

tokens.name: placeholder-gray
tokens.usage: Builder placeholder in the unfinished sections (Location, Q&A, Sponsors, Footer). NOT a design colour — do not ship.

tokens.name: media-gray
tokens.usage: Empty image slot in Gallery before real photos. Placeholder only.

styles.name: numeral

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The camp name in caps when set as text beside the mark.

styles.name: label

tokens.name: space-1

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-22

tokens.name: radius-sm

tokens.name: radius-md

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Emblem discs and round badges.

tokens.name: glow-gold
tokens.usage: Emblem ring and hovered gold elements on navy.

tokens.name: glow-celestial
